- **Front View ($p'q'$):** Since the line PQ is perpendicular to H.P., its front view is a vertical line of true length $50\text{ mm}$, located $40\text{ mm}$ above/perpendicular to the $XY$ reference line (since point P is $30\text{ mm}$ above H.P., the bottom end of the front view starts at $30\text{ mm}$ above $XY$ and extends up to $80\text{ mm}$ above $XY$).
- **Top View ($pq$):** Since the line is perpendicular to the H.P., its top view is a single point located $40\text{ mm}$ below the $XY$ reference line.
proTip: A line perpendicular to H.P. has its top view as a point and its front view showing the true length perpendicular to the XY line.
